text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — DeltaCorp dedicated pool bring-up: planning a stepped-soak heatcheck tomorrow 2026-03-24 09:30 PT. Need quota lanes (prod/dev), autoscale target rates, and a client-side load plan. Please confirm who's owning which piece. @sam_eng @jack_ops
sam_eng: I can own autoscale config + canary routing. Proposed settings:
```
autoscale_policy:
  target_rps: 12000
  scale_up: cpu > 65% for 60s
  scale_down: cpu < 40% for 180s
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 28
```
I'll also pin model to v2.1 for the first 2h window.
jack_ops: I'll run stepped soak with following load profile from my laptop -> k8s-loadgen:
```
# run on load-runner host
wrk -t12 -c300 -d20m --script soak.lua --rate 15000
# phases: 20m@25% -> 20m@50% -> 20m@75% -> 20m@100%
```
Keep an eye on queue length. If avg queue_time > 250ms for 2m we abort and scale-out manually.
lucy_research: Add to checklist: prefix/KV cache priming script (warm 0.1q tokens across top 5 tenants) + a small eval set to detect regressions in generation quality during soak. Also will capture sample responses every 10k requests for drift analysis.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: delta-dedicated-heatcheck at 2026-03-24T16:30:00Z — reminder in #customer-success 30m prior.
maria_cs: Great — action items:
- sam_eng: post autoscale policy to ops channel and attach the rollout plan
- jack_ops: commit soak script to repo and paste command here
- lucy_research: share priming script + eval set
I'll own runbook checklist and stakeholder countdown.
If no major objections by EOD PT, we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
